title: Skill Evolution Plugin Recommendations for MZ

posts.author: K-apple
posts.body:
I currently working with RPG Maker MZ. My goal is to have it so the player's skill can "evolve," as the level up. Something akin to Shin Megami Tensei, rather than Final Fantasy where players keep high and low tier spells. Because I want the player to have a limited pool of skills for each character and have to decided which to keep and which to get rid of allowing for character specific builds.
Effectively, I want to find a plugin where its possible for a character to learn a skill at a particular level (or have it from the start) and have that skill potentially "evolve," or change into another skill. (Example in the image.)
For example: Say you have Fire I at level 5 but at level 10 the skill can change to either Fire II or Ice I. I wanted to see if it's possible to either randomize the change by having a pool of skills that it can change to and give the player the option to opt out of the skill evolution. If not a plugin, I want to know if its possible to code with events.

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
You could always use common events to set this up.
So if Actor 1 is LV1, they have fire.
Each time a battle is cleared, you could trigger a switch, which would then trigger the common event or have a common event trigger after each battle, and what that common event would do is check each actor's level, and depending on their level, the event would play out as removing one skill and adding the other.
So battle won, common event runs, checks if Actor 1 is LV10, if yes, then remove Fire and add Fire II.
(or just have it remove Fire and learn Fire II normally at LV10.)
I think there is a few plugins out there that will automaticly play common events afer each battle is won.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Yeah if you don't find plugin you can event it. VS has common event after battle. Check levels, roll a random variable and select from your lists and then ask if player wants to swap the skill.

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
K-apple said:
Okay but how would I go about randomizing it? Like if you reach level 5 Fire I could turn into Fire II or Ice I.
Click to expand...
Conditional branches and Variables!
Show battle over, Com event runs.
Conditional branch:
If Actor LV10:
Remove skill
Set Variable "Skill random" by Random between 1-2.
Conditional branch: If variable "Skill random" = 1
Learn "Ice"
Else
Learn "Fire"
Now, if you're adding more skills to randomly learn, then add more conditional branches of and change the Random range of the variable "skill random" of 1-X (x being how many skills you want to have)
If Variable "Skill random" = 1
Then learn "Ice."
If Variable "Skill random" = 2
Then learn "Fire II."
If Variable "Skill random" = 3
Then learn "Bolt."
